items.stem: 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

lines: Jake: Ms. Hong, may I come in?
Ms. Hong: Sure, Jake. What’s wrong?
Jake: I feel stressed about the exams next week.
Ms. Hong: Oh, no. How often do you feel this way?
Jake: Almost every time I think about exams.
Ms. Hong: I understand. It’s important to manage your stress during exams.
Jake: But I don’t know how. What should I do?
Ms. Hong: You can take a walk and get some fresh air. Also, you can do some stretching.
Jake: Those are great tips. I will try them.
Ms. Hong: Studying with your friends can also lower your stress.
Jake: Okay. Thank you for your advice!

choices: Jake feels stressed about the exams next week.
Jake feels stressed only once a month.
Ms. Hong tells Jake to study alone.
Jake already knows how to manage his stress.
Ms. Hong says stretching is bad for stress.
items.explain: I feel stressed about the exams next week. ② 시험 생각할 때마다 ③ 친구와 함께 공부 ④ I don’t know how ⑤ 스트레칭을 권함.

items.stem: 어법이 맞는 문장은?
choices: It is very fun play soccer with friends.
The lower the price is, the more people will buy it.
I felt the ground to shake.
It was difficult climb the mountain.
The more you exercise, the strong your body will become.
items.explain: ① to play ③ shake/shaking ④ to climb ⑤ the stronger. 학습지 p.36·37·44 문장 변형.
items.source: 선생님 제작 어법 문장 (학습지 p.36~37 가주어 it · the 비교급 · p.44 지각동사)

items.stem: 대화의 흐름상 밑줄 (A)에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?

lines: B: Look at all the plastic waste!
B: You can recycle plastic cups and bottles.
G: Okay. What else can I do?
B: Don’t forget to carry a reusable bottle.
B: boy, G: girl

choices: What can I do to reduce plastic waste?
Where can I buy plastic cups?
Why do you carry a reusable bottle?
items.explain: You can ~ 으로 답하므로 방법을 묻는 What can I do to ~?

items.stem: 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
items.box:
ⓐ We watched him fix the car.
ⓑ A firefighter smelled the smoke to come from the kitchen.
ⓒ My mom told us to play soccer.
ⓓ The teacher made his student a great singer.
ⓔ She let me to enjoy some warm cookies.
ⓕ I want my friend to help me.
ⓖ Sumi and I heard the rain falling on the tent.
items.explain: 지각동사 + 동사원형/현재분사(ⓑ come/coming), 사역 let + 동사원형(ⓔ enjoy), tell/want + to부정사, make + 목적어 + 명사 보어.
items.source: 선생님 제작 어법 문장 (학습지 p.44 grammar 3-E 지각동사 + 26-1 기말 3·29·30번 사역·5형식 연계 확장)

box.title: Pages from Our School Year
lines: Sports Day: The final soccer game was the biggest event. (A) We cheered for Class 1 and 3 at the school playground.
Photo Contest: We won first place in a school photo contest. (B)
Volunteer Day: We picked up trash while jogging. (C) It was good for the Earth and our health.
Class Field Trip: We went to an amusement park. (D) We tried many rides, and we watched an amazing parade! (E)

items.stem: 윗글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: How to win a photo contest
items.explain: 운동회·사진 대회·봉사의 날·현장 학습 — 한 해의 추억.

items.stem: (A)~(E) 중 <보기>의 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: This photo was taken in front of a huge tree.

items.explain: 사진 대회에서 1등 → 이 사진은 큰 나무 앞에서 찍혔다.

items.stem: 대화의 밑줄 (A)~(E) 중 윗글과 내용이 일치하지 <u>않는</u> 것은?

lines: Hajin: Look at these pages from our school year!
Semi: (A)<u>The final soccer game was the biggest event on Sports Day.</u>
Hajin: Right. (B)<u>We cheered for Class 1 and 3 at the school playground.</u>
Semi: (C)<u>We won second place in the school photo contest.</u>
Hajin: And on Volunteer Day, (D)<u>we picked up trash while jogging.</u>
Semi: (E)<u>On the class field trip, we went to an amusement park and watched an amazing parade.</u>
Hajin: What a great year!

items.explain: We won first place in a school photo contest. (대화는 본문을 옮겨 지은 것)
items.source: L6 Team Project (교과서 기타 지문) · 대화는 선생님 제작

items.stem: 대화를 읽고 답할 수 <u>없는</u> 질문은?

lines: G: What are you reading, Liam?
B: I’m reading an article about teens’ selfie habits.
G: That’s interesting. How often do teens take selfies?
B: It says many teens take selfies every day.
G: Wow! I often see my friends posting their selfies on social media.
B: The article also says it’s important to be careful about sharing selfies online.
G: Why is that important?
B: Because selfies can have personal information in them.
G: Right. Anyone can see that information.
B: Yeah. We should think twice before posting selfies.
B: boy, G: girl

choices: How often do many teens take selfies?
Why is it important to be careful about sharing selfies online?
How many selfies does the girl take a day?
What should we do before posting selfies?
items.explain: ① 십 대 셀카 습관 기사 ② every day ③ 개인 정보 ⑤ think twice. ④ 언급 없음.

box.title: Save the City on the Water
lines: Hello, friends! My name is Monica, and I live in Venice. (A)<u>Have you heard of Venice?</u> It is a beautiful city on the water in Italy. Venice is famous for its canals and historic buildings. (B)<u>Many tourists comes to see them every year.</u> But now, we have a big problem. (C)<u>Last week, the streets were flooded.</u> I couldn’t go to school, and my parents’ bakery had to close. I had to wear tall rain boots all the time. I’m really worried. (G)<u>The warmer the Earth gets, the higher the water in Venice rises.</u> (D)<u>Venice could be underwater soon.</u> (F)(E)<u>My city need your help!</u>

items.stem: (A)~(E) 중 어법이 바르지 <u>않은</u> 것의 개수는?
items.explain: (B) Many tourists come (E) My city needs — 주어·동사 수일치. (A) 현재완료 (C) 수동태 맞음. 일부러 바꿔 쓴 문장.
items.source: L5 본문 1대목 Monica (교과서 본문) — (B)(E) 는 어법 문항용 변형

items.stem: 밑줄 (D)가 의미하는 바로 가장 알맞은 것은?
choices: Venice may go under the water in the near future.
Venice will build more canals soon.
Monica will move to another city.
The rain boots will be sold soon.
items.explain: 수위가 올라 곧 물에 잠길 수도 있다. 기출 10번(속담) 자리를 밑줄 의미 추론으로.

items.stem: 밑줄 (G)가 나타내는 내용을 비교급을 쓰지 않고 두 문장으로 풀어 쓰시오. (4점)
items.answer: The Earth gets warm. The water in Venice rises high.
items.explain: 「the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 …」 = 두 문장의 원급 관계. 학습지 p.35 B 의 풀어 쓰기 방식.
items.source: L5 본문 1대목 Monica · 학습지 p.35 the 비교급

items.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 순서대로 바르게 배열한 것은?

lines: Lucy: Jake, are you throwing out that backpack?
Jake: Yeah. I don’t really use it anymore.
Jake: That sounds good. I’ll give it a try.
(A) Right. Someone can still use my backpack. What can I do to find a new owner for it?
(B) You can sell it through an online flea market.
(C) But it looks new. These days, people throw out so many good items.

items.explain: 새것처럼 보인다 → 새 주인을 찾을 방법 묻기 → 온라인 벼룩시장.

items.stem: 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
choices: The earlier you start, the sooner you will finish.
The colder it gets, the more clothes he wears.
I watched my friend take a selfie.
The more we laugh, the closer we become.
The more questions you ask, the more well you understand.
items.explain: well 의 비교급은 better → the better you understand. 학습지 p.36·38·45 문장.
items.source: 학습지 p.36·38 L5 grammar the 비교급 · p.45 지각동사

items.stem: 밑줄 친 단어의 쓰임이 의미상 <u>어색한</u> 문장은?
choices: She <u>flipped</u> the pancake over in the pan.
I stretched my legs during <u>halftime</u> at the basketball game.
I <u>spent</u> all my money on clothes.
I <u>screamed</u> late last night to finish the book.
items.explain: I stayed up late last night to finish the book.

box.title: Club News: Spreading Cheer Everywhere
lines: Let’s meet Fly High, our school’s cheerleading club. The club started from an idea of one student two years ago. Now, there (A)( is / are ) 10 girls and 6 boys in the club. Each member has a special energy. Do you remember the recent school basketball game? After two quarters, our team was losing by 20 points. During halftime, Fly High came on the court. They performed wonderfully. They flipped in the air and made a human pyramid. Then they shouted, “(D)______________!” And guess what? Our team won the game in the end. Jina, the captain of the club, said, “I can flip in the air because I trust my club members. When I see the crowd (B)( cheering / to cheer ) and screaming, I feel proud. Fly High is the best part of my middle school life!” You can watch Fly High (C)( doing / to do ) their performance at the school festival next week. Come and feel their energy!

items.stem: Jina가 공중에서 돌 수 있는 이유는?
items.explain: I can flip in the air because I trust my club members.

items.stem: (A)~(C)에 알맞은 것은?
items.explain: (A) there are + 복수 (B)(C) 지각동사 see/watch + 목적어 + 현재분사(동사원형). to부정사 불가.
items.source: L6 본문 1대목 Fly High · 학습지 p.42 수일치 · 지각동사

items.stem: 밑줄 (D)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 응원 동아리의 외침 → 결국 우리 팀이 이겼다.

items.stem: <보기>의 문장 중 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것의 개수는?

box.title: <보기>
lines: - Fly High is the school’s cheerleading club.
- The club started two years ago.
- There are more boys than girls in the club.
- Our team was losing by 20 points after two quarters.
- Fly High performed during halftime.
- Our team won the game in the end.
- Jina is the captain of Fly High.

items.explain: 일치 6개. 불일치: more boys than girls(10 girls, 6 boys).

items.stem: <보기>의 어떤 빈칸에도 들어갈 수 <u>없는</u> 단어는?

box.title: <보기>
lines: - I will ________ out how to get to the museum.
- The flowers in the garden will ________ soon.
- He can ________ his time very well.
- Our family joined a campaign to ________ water at home.

items.explain: find / grow / manage / save. 학습지 예문 그대로.
items.source: 학습지 p.33 L5 · p.40 L6 vocabulary 1 예문

lines: Hi, Monica! I’m Timothy from the United States. (A)<u>My</u> family visited Venice three years ago and we loved (B)<u>it</u>! I am surprised and sad to hear your news. I want to do my part to help (C)<u>your city</u> and the Earth. I recently found out something interesting. (F)<u>The more meat we eat, the hot our planet gets.</u> (D)<u>This</u> is because lots of trees are cut down to make animal farms. This increases greenhouse gases. Also, cows pass a lot of gas. Smelly! But (E)<u>this</u> is not the worst part. The gas from cows also adds to greenhouse gases. Greenhouse gases make the Earth hotter. So, (H)<u>나는 지구 온난화를 늦추기 위해 고기를 덜 먹으려고 노력하고 있어.</u> (G)<u>It isn’t easy change my eating habits, but I’m doing my best.</u>

items.stem: <보기> 중 밑줄 (A)~(E)와 지시하는 대상이 바르게 연결된 것을 모두 고른 것은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: ⓐ (A) My – Timothy’s
ⓑ (B) it – Venice
ⓒ (C) your city – Venice
ⓓ (D) This – greenhouse gases
ⓔ (E) this – cows passing a lot of gas

items.explain: (D) This = 고기를 더 먹을수록 행성이 더 뜨거워진다는 사실(앞 문장). 나머지 맞음.

items.stem: <보기>의 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어 중 윗글에 있지 <u>않은</u> 것은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: ⓐ a piece of land used for growing crops or raising animals
ⓑ a gas that contributes to the greenhouse effect by absorbing infrared radiation
ⓒ a usual way of behaving, something that a person does often in a regular and repeated way
ⓓ a role or function played by someone or something in a particular situation or event
ⓔ a narrow waterway built by people for boats or to bring water to fields

items.explain: ⓐ farm ⓑ greenhouse gas ⓒ habit ⓓ part 는 본문에 있음. ⓔ canal 은 없음.

items.stem: 밑줄 (F)와 (G)를 어법에 맞게 고쳐 문장 전체를 다시 쓰시오. (6점, 각 3점)
items.answer: (1) The more meat we eat, the hotter our planet gets. (2) It isn’t easy to change my eating habits, but I’m doing my best.
items.explain: (F) the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 … (hot → hotter) (G) 가주어 It + 진주어 to부정사. 본문 문장을 일부러 틀리게 바꿔 실었다.
items.source: L5 본문 2대목 Timothy · 학습지 p.35 the 비교급 · 가주어 it

items.stem: <보기>에서 필요한 단어만 골라 (H)의 해석에 맞게 영어 문장을 완성하시오. (단, 필요한 경우 형태를 바꿀 수 있음.) (4점)

box.title: <보기>
lines: I, am, try, to, eat, less, little, meat, slow down, global warming, so, for

items.answer: I’m trying to eat less meat to slow down global warming. (I am trying 도 인정)
items.explain: try to + 동사원형, less meat, to부정사(목적) slow down.

items.stem: <보기>를 읽고 지각동사를 포함한 문장을 2개 완성하시오. (6점, 각 3점)

box.title: <보기>
lines: The smoke was coming from the kitchen. A firefighter smelled it.
The rain was falling on the tent. Sumi and I heard it.
(1) A firefighter smelled ______________________ from the kitchen.
(2) Sumi and I heard ______________________ on the tent.

items.answer: (1) the smoke coming (come) (2) the rain falling (fall)
items.explain: 지각동사 smell/hear + 목적어 + 현재분사/동사원형. 학습지 p.44 E-7·8 문장.

items.stem: 조건에 맞게 문장을 완성하시오. (4점)

lines: <보기> is, it, important, keep, to, your desk, tidy
Eric’s desk is so messy. His friend says,

condition: 조건 1. <보기>에 주어진 단어를 모두 사용할 것.
items.answer: It is important to keep your desk tidy.
items.explain: 가주어 It + is + 형용사 + to부정사(진주어).
items.source: L6 Listen & Speak 1-A2 · 학습지 p.35 가주어 it

items.stem: Tom이 Amy에게 의류 쓰레기를 줄이기 위한 방법을 묻는 대화문이 되도록 밑줄 (A)에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오. (4점)

lines: Amy: You can buy less clothing.
Tom: Okay. What else can I do?
Amy: Don’t forget to donate old clothing.

items.answer: What can I do to reduce clothing waste
items.explain: 방법 묻기: What can I do to + 동사원형 ~?

items.stem: 대화를 읽고 조건에 맞게 답하시오. (12점, 각 3점)

lines: B: I feel tired these days.
G: (A)<u>너는 얼마나 자주 충분한 잠을 자니, 세준아?</u>
B: Once a week. I usually stay up late watching videos.
G: (B)<u>매일 밤 8시간의 잠을 자는 것이 중요해.</u>
B: You’re right. I’ll try to go to bed earlier. (C)<u>나는 어젯밤 내 남동생이 일찍 잠자리에 드는 것을 보았어.</u>
G: Great. (D)<u>네가 더 일찍 잠자리에 들수록, 너는 더 많은 에너지를 가질 거야.</u>
B: boy, G: girl

condition: 조건 1. 밑줄 (A)~(C)는 괄호 안의 말을 이용하여 영작할 것. (A) (how often, get enough sleep) (B) (it, important, get, eight hours of sleep) (C) (see, my brother, go to bed, early, last night)
조건 2. 밑줄 (D)는 「the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 …」을 사용하여 영작할 것. (early, go to bed, much energy, have)
items.answer: (A) How often do you get enough sleep, Sejun? (B) It’s important to get eight hours of sleep every night. (C) I saw my brother go to bed early last night. (going 도 인정) (D) The earlier you go to bed, the more energy you will have.
items.explain: (A) 빈도 묻기 (B) 가주어 it (C) 지각동사 see + 목적어 + 동사원형/현재분사 (D) the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 … (학습지 p.37 B-(3)). (C)(D) 는 대화 흐름에 맞춰 지은 문장.
items.source: L6 Listen & Speak 1-A3 (교과서 대화문) · 학습지 p.35 · p.37 · p.44 — (C)(D) 선생님 제작
